message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side line charts compare baseline and attributing performance across training steps on AppWorld and BFCL v3.","description":"The target picture contains two line charts. Both use Training Steps (%) on the x-axis, with plotted points at 0, 10, …, 100, and Avg@8 (%) on the y-axis. The left panel is labeled “(a) AppWorld”; its y-axis has ticks from 20 to 60. The right panel is labeled “(b) BFCL v3”; its y-axis has ticks from 40 to 70. In each panel, the legend identifies Baseline as a dashed gray line with circular markers and Attributing as a solid magenta line with triangular markers. There are no arrows or check/cross marks, and no numeric labels printed beside the plotted points; values are estimated from the axes. In AppWorld, both series start near 18. Attributing rises faster early, then stays generally above Baseline, and finishes near 60 versus about 54.5. In BFCL v3, both start near 42; Attributing rises to about 65 by 30 steps and remains above the fluctuating Baseline through the end, finishing near 65 versus about
